announcements.headline: AFARAK GROUP SE AND ITS GROUP COMPANIES ARE EVALUATING POTENTIAL ACQUISITION OF THE METAL FACTORY OF ABS SISAK D.O.O. LOCATED IS SISAK, CROATIA.
